statement: As of 2026-09-23, among the ten Taipei restaurants in James C. Lin's 500盤 2026 selection, 醇一拉麵 is the only restaurant with evidence consistent with a realistic one-person meal at or below NT$400; the other nine are excluded under the hard all-in budget rule.
notes: Exact current prices for some excluded fine-dining restaurants may differ, but all captured floors are far above NT$400. 醇一 remains on freshness watch pending first-party Sep-2026 menu verification.
